# KaTeX 0.19.1

Pinned browser assets from [KaTeX](https://katex.org/), distributed under the
[MIT license](./LICENSE). The dashboard serves these files locally; equation
rendering and fonts do not require a CDN or another network connection.

- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.1.tgz
- Package metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/0.19.1
- Auto-render documentation: https://katex.org/docs/autorender.html
- Archive SHA-256: `24da5a599eb2fcede2e270b99a6ff48bca816beecc95feeb84e8cccbd1bb34fd`

The archive's SHA-512 digest was verified against its npm `dist.integrity`
metadata. Only the regular files `dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/katex.min.css`,
`dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js`, `LICENSE`, and the 60 WOFF2/WOFF/TTF font
files referenced by the stylesheet were copied. Their upstream contents are
unchanged, with the `dist/` prefix removed. No package scripts or archive-wide
extraction were used.
